title: Payable assessment selection evidence

decision.boundary: Validate inert trusted evidence that one exact FOOD-005J payable-assessment version has been explicitly selected for one exact FOOD-005E order identity/version. The selection does not infer latest/current from revision numbers and grants no checkout, payment, reservation, fulfillment, sale, accounting or rewards authority.
whyNow: FOOD-005J supports immutable historical assessment versions and consecutive revisions but does not establish which historical version is authorized for downstream use.
FOOD-005Q proves exact authorized fulfillment-charge inclusion in one exact assessment but explicitly grants no latest/current/usable assessment selection.
A later readiness boundary must not silently consume an arbitrary or repository-latest FOOD-005J assessment.
Explicit exact selection evidence is narrower than checkout/payment readiness and independent of atomic reservation persistence.

authority.trustedSelection: The caller supplies trusted explicit selection evidence. FOOD-005R validates that evidence against one exact valid FOOD-005J assessment version.
authority.assessmentValidation: The supplied FOOD-005J assessment must pass validateFoodPayableAssessmentVersion.
authority.orderBinding: Selection order ID/version must exactly equal the selected assessment order ID/version.
authority.assessmentBinding: Selection payable-assessment ID/version must exactly equal the supplied assessment ID/version.

order.id: exact FOOD-005E order identity carried by FOOD-005J
order.version: exact positive safe integer order version

payableAssessment.version: exact positive safe integer assessment version

invariants: selection evidence != live inventory or slot reservation
selection must bind exact order ID/version
selection must bind exact payable-assessment ID/version
a valid historical assessment version may be explicitly selected
higher version number does not automatically supersede selection authority
selection evidence is detached and immutable
deferred: atomic inventory/slot persistence and race protection
